title: Drummer Carter and Joe Wells of the Silver Leaf band
summary: Carter died young; Joe Wells, once a violinist, drummed with Charles until he quit.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh, I wanted to ask you about this guy Carter, back to the Silverleaf Band. Whatever happened to him? I never heard of him. He died.
Did he play with other bands too?
No, just with us. We were the only band he played with. And he just passed. Passed too, yeah. Then we got a little Joe Wells. I don't know if you knew him. He was a violin player or heard of him?
No, a drummer. I thought he was the one who played violin before or something.

Yeah, he played violin before. That was his first instrument. That's right. He showed his right on that. That was his first instrument. Yeah, I heard of him. Then he went on the drum. Well that's the only instrument he really played, that drum. Oh yeah, he could play that drum, because he played with me until I quit. Yeah, he could play that drum.
